Asha Patel: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need to make the escalation thresholds explicit in the runbook. Right now it's subjective. Suggestion: Tier 1 (evictions 50-99/min) -> oncall only; Tier 2 (100-199/min) -> page runtime lead; Tier 3 (>=200/min) -> page infra + exec.
Tom Baker: Sounds good. Also flag in the playbook that if the canary responds with 5xxs, do not promote and immediately run the diagnostic checklist.
Leila Gomez: I'll draft the wording for the escalation matrix and push a small PR. Due 2026-03-24.
runbook-bot: Created RB-4445 "Define explicit escalation tiers + diagnostic gating" assigned to Leila Gomez. Due 2026-03-24.
Asha Patel: Also add a short "known patterns" section summarizing the recent incidents and the likely GC race root cause. Link to incident IDs 2395000001,2396000002.
Tom Baker: We should also make sure the runbook has an owner rotation note and a playbook contact list with pager IDs. That reduces confusion at 2am.
Leila Gomez: On it. I'll include pager IDs and a rotation cron sample.
Asha Patel: Great, after PR merges, we'll mark postmortem actions as resolved.
